title: Order-to-Cash Survey Data File
descriptions: In the survey companies were asked about quantitative and qualitative details of their order-to-cash process. The order-to-cash process starts when the order comes in and ends when payment is made by the customer. The shorter this process is, the sooner suppliers receive their money, which is good for their working capital position and usually also for transaction costs.The data could first of all be of use for researchers who want to investigate order-to-cash processes. Second, this data could be used in statistics classes for basic statistical analyses, mainly descriptive statistics due to the amount of answers (116), and to a limited extent inferential statistics.
